notes: Heuristic per-spirit terrain scoring for win-probability modelling. Each spirit has a baseline affinity for each terrain (-1..+1 where + means the spirit handles invaders in that terrain well; - means it suffers there), and a `concentration` factor (how the spirit responds when a terrain doubles or triples across a turn: positive = concentration helps, negative = concentration hurts). Values are authored estimates marked [VERIFY] until physical-play data refines them.

shadows-flicker-like-flame.rationale: Shadows's Fear output scales with enemy density — concentrated invader clusters are fear-efficient. Mild jungle preference via Darkness-affinity aspect + Mantle push targeting. [VERIFY]

lightning-swift-strike.rationale: Lightning strikes hardest on big piles — Fast damage scales well with concentration; Jagged Lightning and Thundering Destruction hit more effectively with doubled-up invaders. [VERIFY]

river-surges-in-sunlight.rationale: River pushes across the coast/wetland line; strong wetland affinity; concentration hurts because it reduces push targets and complicates the draining cycle. [VERIFY]

vital-strength-of-the-earth.rationale: Vital Strength absorbs more hits than it prevents — concentrated invaders let its damage-scaling uniques (Guard the Healing Land, Rituals of the Destroying Flame) hit more at once. [VERIFY]

ocean-hungry-grasp.rationale: Ocean dominates coastal terrain and Coastal Lands invader cards are catastrophic in its favor. Inland concentration is neutral at best. [VERIFY]

a-spread-of-rampant-green.rationale: Rampant Green's Defend scales with presence; jungle/wetland preference from its archetypal growth pattern; mild concentration benefit via Gift of Proliferation copying. [VERIFY]

thunderspeaker.rationale: Thunderspeaker needs Dahan adjacency; concentration in invader terrain typically disperses spirit focus and leaves Dahan unsupported. [VERIFY]

bringer-of-dreams-and-nightmares.rationale: Bringer's Fear scaling is fear-per-kill and area-effect heavy; concentrated invaders mean bigger fear bursts from Lure of the Deep Wilderness and Predatory Nightmares. [VERIFY]

rising-heat-of-stone-and-sand.rationale: Rising Heat lives on mountain/sands; struggles in wetland. Concentration helps its Fire-scaling damage innates. [VERIFY]

sun-bright-whirlwind.rationale: Whirlwind covers ground with fast push-from-range; concentration slightly penalizes because it reduces target diversity. [VERIFY]

devouring-teeth-lurk-underfoot.rationale: Teeth's damage scales hard with per-land explorer/town counts — concentrated invader terrain is a feast. [VERIFY]

eyes-watch-from-the-trees.rationale: Eyes's Sacred-Site + Plant + Animal focus aligns with jungle; concentration mildly benefits via shared element triggers. [VERIFY]

fathomless-mud-of-the-swamp.rationale: Mud is a wetland-dominant spirit. Concentration dilutes its strength as it needs to spread Presence for Disease tokens + Innate triggers. [VERIFY]

keeper-of-the-forbidden-wilds.rationale: Keeper pushes and defends jungle+mountain preferentially via Wilds Aflame / Boon of Reclamation. [VERIFY]

heart-of-the-wildfire.rationale: Wildfire is the archetype 'concentration is strength' spirit — its blight-spread + innate fire damage is exponential with invader density. [VERIFY]

serpent-slumbering-beneath-the-island.rationale: Serpent's big-hammer release scales with accumulated invaders; concentrated terrain reveals are favorable. [VERIFY]

grinning-trickster.rationale: Trickster trades board-state for surprise; concentration is mildly beneficial for AoE effects. [VERIFY]
